title: Grade 6 Science — Mon, May 18
description: Food: Where Does It Come From? — Day 1 of 5: Sources of food
subject: science

questions.question: What are the two main sources of food for humans?
questions.explanation: All food ultimately comes from plants or animals. Even processed food has plant or animal origins.

questions.question: Which part of a rice plant do we eat?
questions.explanation: Rice is the seed (grain) of the rice plant. We eat the seed.

questions.question: We eat the root of which vegetable?
questions.explanation: Carrot, radish, beetroot, and turnip are roots that we eat.

questions.question: We eat the leaf of which vegetable?
questions.explanation: Spinach, cabbage, methi (fenugreek), and lettuce are leaves that we eat.

questions.question: Which food comes from an animal source?
questions.explanation: Milk comes from animals (cows, buffalo, goats). It is an animal product.

questions.question: Honey is made by:
questions.explanation: Honey bees make honey by collecting nectar from flowers and processing it in the hive.

questions.question: Mustard oil comes from which part of the mustard plant?
questions.explanation: Mustard oil is extracted from mustard seeds. Many cooking oils come from seeds (sunflower, coconut, sesame).

questions.question: What do we call animals that provide us food like milk, eggs, and meat?
questions.explanation: Domestic animals like cow, hen, goat, and pig are kept for food (milk, eggs, meat).

questions.question: Which plant part is a potato?
questions.explanation: Potato is a stem tuber — a modified underground stem that stores food.

questions.question: Sugar is obtained mainly from:
questions.explanation: Sugar is extracted from sugarcane (in India) or sugar beet. The stem of sugarcane is used.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a plant product?
questions.explanation: Eggs come from hens — they are an animal product. Rice, dal, and wheat are plant products.

questions.question: We eat the flower of which vegetable?
questions.explanation: Cauliflower and broccoli are flowers that we eat.

questions.question: Fish is which type of food source?
questions.explanation: Fish is an animal source of food, rich in protein and omega-3 fatty acids.

questions.question: Dal is made from:
options: Seeds of legumes (pulses like lentil, moong, chana)
questions.explanation: Dal is made from seeds of legumes (pulses). Moong, masoor, arhar, chana are common pulses.

questions.question: Curd (yoghurt) is prepared from which animal product?
questions.explanation: Curd is made by fermenting milk with bacteria (Lactobacillus). It is a dairy product.
